Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarantine: PO issuance blocked by onboarding form gaps

Hi David / Monica,

We submitted our onboarding packet yesterday via the portal, but it looks like the system didn't generate a PO number on your side and our integration team is blocked. I attached the form we uploaded (Novum_Onboarding_Form.pdf) — the fields on our end were filled, but the portal returned an incomplete acknowledgement.

We have a short window to get the first integration sprint started next week. Can you confirm whether you can issue a provisional PO (even with a spend cap) so we can begin work, or do you need anything else from our side? If tax or VAT paperwork is required I can get that over immediately.

Thanks,
Sarah Lee
Vendor Operations Lead
NovumTech

Attachment: Novum_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf, 420 KB stub)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@novumtech.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Quarantine: PO issuance blocked by onboarding form gaps

Monica / Markus —

Looping you in. Quick read: vendor submitted a packet but the intake shows two blocking items that prevent full PO issuance: 1) formal VAT / tax certificate is missing (portal accepted a transient value), and 2) line-itemization on the form is ambiguous — the "professional services" line lacks a clear unit qty/rate so our billing ledger can't create a canonical PO.

Until we get the VAT cert and clarified line items we should not create a full PO. However, I agree we should avoid blocking go-live. Proposed approach: issue a provisional PO with a strict spend cap and split the charges into two temporary line items (integration implementation + onboarding support hours). That will let Novum start work while we finish doc ingestion and validate tax docs.

Please evaluate exposure and confirm a provisional PO number and cap. If legal insists on a higher review, we'll escalate; otherwise provisionally limit to $7,500 and require signed acceptance and updated VAT cert before we lift the cap.

Thanks,
David
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference

- Spend cap: USD 7,500 (hard cap — any overage must be pre-approved)

I've attached the provisional PO stub (PO-2026-99431-PROV.pdf). Sarah, please countersign and return; we'll route funds under the provisional code and tag the account for intake completion.
